context_for_next_testing_agent: Exit Parameters feature fully implemented and tested. Key findings: 1) Exit Parameters tab on Configuration page (/config) shows all 4 strategies with sliders for TP/SL/MaxHours. 2) Preset buttons (Conservative, Moderate, Aggressive) work for each strategy. 3) Save Changes persists to MongoDB. 4) GET /api/config returns exit_params with all 4 strategies. 5) POST /api/config/update saves exit_params correctly. 6) Paper trading loads exit_params from DB when starting. 7) Default values: delta_neutral={TP:2%, SL:-2%, 4h}, volatility={TP:5%, SL:-5%, 8h}, alpha={TP:8%, SL:-5%, 12h}, arbitrage={TP:3%, SL:-3%, 6h}.

get_config_api.returns: exit_params with all 4 strategies (delta_neutral, volatility_exploitation, alpha_directional, arbitrage)

update_config_api.accepts: exit_params object with strategy-specific TP/SL/MaxHours values

paper_trading_config_loading.notes: Paper trading loads exit_params from DB when starting session
